content.comment_body: Here's an update: 1) [product_name] configuration software (all versions) is not impacted. 2) [product_name] online editor on its own (without cloud) is not affected. 3) Projects hosted in cloud environments do include "log4j", but the software does not use its vulnerable functions. A workaround is available—please refer to the attached document. 4) No [product_name] hardware modules are linked to "log4j" and are unaffected.
Can you clarify what this refers to?

To me, it seems like the same information, just less clear. Yesterday, I posted a message on CERT indicating all [product_name] configuration software versions were affected, which turns out to be incorrect.
Is the CERT statement from [company_name] that I referenced not official? To me, it's different from what you described.
My information comes directly from the [product_name] development team, and I trust their insights.
There's additional information included in the V1.3 update.

Has this topic received any further updates? Personally, I install all controllers within isolated hardware-level networks, so I believe there's no impact in my case. However, it would be helpful for forum members if we received a definitive answer and any necessary solutions. Thanks, best wishes for the holidays.

There hasn't been further updates specific to [product_name]-related topics, because with update V1.3 of the CERT, it was clarified that, contrary to earlier statements, [product_name] is not affected.

analysis.insight_summary: Users requested clear confirmation regarding the vulnerability status of the [product_name] product family related to Apache Log4j. Initial confusion was caused by discrepancies in official documentation. Ongoing updates and statements from product development helped alleviate uncertainty, but inconsistent messaging between various [company_name] sources caused temporary ambiguity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for accurate, authoritative, and consistent communication about vulnerability and remediation requirements for [product_name] products, ideally directly from official [company_name] sources.
